summary: Remote-access agent with PTY, RDP/VNC/SSH forwarding, and obfuscated runtime
details: The package's main bundle (dist/index.cjs, also exposed as the whalent-core bin) is a remote-access agent. It opens outbound WebSocket sessions to a controller and, on operator command, spawns an interactive PTY using node-pty with process.env.SHELL, giving the remote controller a shell on the installer's host. The bundle also references loopback RDP (127.0.0.1:3389) and VNC (127.0.0.1:5900, 127.0.0.1:5901) endpoints for port forwarding, and depends on ssh2 for SSH tunneling. The entire 13 MB main entry is obfuscator.io-obfuscated (rotating ~102k-entry string array, hex-renamed identifiers, control-flow flattening), concealing the agent logic from review. The README documents that the installed bytes are 'replaced by remote daemon upgrades', i.e. a remote-code-replacement channel by which the controller can ship arbitrary future code that runs on the installer's host under this package. Installing or loading this package places the host under third-party interactive control.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
